seo.title: Pump Efficiency Calculator - Wire to Water
seo.description: Pump Efficiency Calculator — Calculate pump hydraulic efficiency, wire-to-water efficiency, and energy losses with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: Efficiency η = Hydraulic Power / Shaft Power × 100%. Hydraulic = ρQgh (W); power_input converted to W by engine. Result in percent.

content.introduction: Calculate pump efficiency from hydraulic output power and input shaft power. Typical centrifugal pump best efficiency point (BEP) is 70-85%. Wire-to-water efficiency also accounts for motor efficiency.

example.description: 100 m³/h × 50m head, 22 kW shaft input: 62.1% efficiency. Hydraulic power = 13.65 kW.

faq.a: Centrifugal pumps: 70-85% at BEP for medium/large pumps; 50-70% for small pumps. Positive displacement: 65-80%.
It includes motor efficiency: η_total = η_pump × η_motor. Typical motor efficiency is 85-95%, so wire-to-water is 60-75%.
